name: Windows Vista / 7 (Aero)
framework: Windows Vista / Windows 7 · Aero Glass (common controls v6, Explorer, Task Dialog, UAC)

elements.name: Balloon
elements.doc: Notification balloon pointing at its child: Balloon("Title", message: "…") { TrayIcon("shield") }

elements.name: BrandGlyph
elements.doc: Neutral glyph standing in for the system logo

elements.name: CategoryLink
elements.doc: Control Panel category with a 32 px icon

elements.name: ClockGadget
elements.doc: Analog clock gadget (hands at 10:10); the text is the caption under the face

elements.name: CommandBar
elements.doc: Explorer's dark blue command bar: CommandButton("Organize", dropdown: true)…

elements.name: CommandButton
elements.doc: A command bar button (white text, glass on hover)

elements.name: CommandLink
elements.doc: Task dialog command link: green arrow, title and subtitle:

elements.name: ConsentBanner
elements.doc: UAC banner: coloured band with a shield: ConsentBanner("A program needs your permission", severity: .warning)

elements.name: ContextMenu
elements.doc: Pop-up menu with the icon gutter

elements.name: Desktop
elements.doc: The desktop with an aurora-like wallpaper; place windows, icons and gadgets with .position(x:y:)

elements.name: DesktopIcon
elements.doc: DesktopIcon("Computer", systemImage: "computer") — 48 px icon, white label; .selected()

elements.name: DetailsPane
elements.doc: The gradient Details pane at the foot of Explorer: DetailsPane("Report.docx", subtitle:, systemImage:) { PropertyRow(…) }

elements.name: DialogBody
elements.doc: Root of a dialog screen: the frame keeps only Close (and ? with .variant(.help))

elements.name: DialogFooter
elements.doc: The grey footer band of a dialog (buttons, a 'Details' expander) — last child of DialogBody

elements.name: DropDownList
elements.doc: Drop-down list drawn as a glossy button

elements.name: ExpandoButton
elements.doc: Task dialog's 'See details' expander: round arrow button and its label

elements.name: FileIcon
GadgetSidebar
elements.doc: The translucent Sidebar strip holding gadgets

elements.name: IconView
elements.doc: Icons view: a grid of FileIcon

elements.name: ListView
elements.doc: Details view: columns:, TableRow children or rows:, sortColumn:, selectedRows:

elements.name: MainInstruction
elements.doc: The big blue (#003399) main instruction of a task dialog or Aero wizard

elements.name: MenuBarItem
elements.doc: A menu bar title; .selected() when open

elements.name: NavigationBar
elements.doc: The glass strip with Back/Forward, the breadcrumb and the search box

elements.name: NavigationPane
elements.doc: Explorer's left pane: NavigationPane("Favorite Links") { FavoriteLink(…) }

elements.name: NotificationArea
elements.doc: Tray at the right of the taskbar: TrayIcon… Clock

elements.name: PowerMenuButton
elements.doc: The arrow opening the shut-down menu

elements.name: ProgressBar
elements.doc: Green glossy progress bar; .variant(.paused) yellow, .variant(.error) red

elements.name: PushButton
elements.doc: Glossy push button; .state(.hover) light-blue, .variant(.default) blue border

elements.name: SearchBox
elements.doc: Explorer search box (italic prompt, magnifier at the right)

elements.name: StartMenu
elements.doc: Glass Start menu: StartMenu("Alex", avatar:, avatarImage:) { StartMenuPrograms{…} StartMenuPlaces{…} }

elements.name: StartMenuPlaces
elements.doc: The glass right pane (user folders, Control Panel, power buttons)

elements.name: StartMenuPrograms
elements.doc: The white left pane (programs, All Programs, Start Search)

elements.name: StartOrb
elements.doc: The round glossy Start orb with a neutral glyph; .selected() while the menu is open

elements.name: StartSearch
elements.doc: The search box at the foot of the Start menu

elements.name: TabControl
elements.sample: TabControl() { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: TabPage
elements.sample: TabView { TabPage("Inbox") { Text("Inbox content") }; TabPage("Archive") { Text("Archive content") } }

elements.name: TaskDialog
elements.doc: Task dialog: white content (MainInstruction, text, CommandLinks) over a grey footer of buttons: TaskDialog("Caption", systemImage:) { … } actions: { … }

elements.name: Taskbar
elements.doc: The black glass taskbar: StartOrb, QuickLaunch, TaskbarButton…, NotificationArea

elements.name: TaskbarButton
elements.doc: A window's glass taskbar button; .selected() for the active window

elements.name: TreeView
elements.doc: Tree with the Vista hollow/filled triangles

elements.name: WeatherGadget
elements.doc: Weather gadget: WeatherGadget("Harbor City", "21°", change: "H 24° L 15°", systemImage: "sun")

elements.name: Window
elements.doc: An Aero glass window drawn inside a Desktop: Window("Pictures", systemImage: "photo") { … } · .variant(.inactive | .dialog | .tool)

elements.name: Wizard
elements.doc: Aero wizard page: main instruction header, white body, grey footer actions: { Next · Cancel }

elements.name: Alert
elements.sample: Alert("Delete this draft?", message: "The draft and its attachments will be removed permanently.", actions: { Button("Cancel", role: .cancel); Button("Delete", role: .destructive) })

elements.name: Canvas
elements.doc: free-form area; place children with .position(x:y:); grid: .dots|.lines

elements.name: Dialog
elements.sample: Dialog("Rename file", message: "Enter a new name for the report.", actions: { Button("Cancel"); Button("Rename") }) { TextField("Name", text: "Quarterly report") }

elements.name: Grid
elements.doc: Grid of GridRow children, or columns: n

elements.name: KanbanCard
elements.doc: title, description:, tags: [..], assignees: [..], due:, comments:, priority:

elements.name: MessageBubble
elements.doc: MessageBubble("Hi", from: .me|.them, author:, time:, status:, reactions: [..])
elements.sample: MessageBubble("Running ten minutes late because the train stopped outside the station, so please start the meeting without me.", author: "Ana Lima", time: "09:41")

elements.name: NavigationSplitView
Placeholder
elements.doc: A labelled box for maps, charts, media

elements.name: SelectionRect
elements.doc: a drag-selection rectangle; size with .frame, place with .position

elements.name: Sheet
Spreadsheet
elements.doc: rows: [[…]], selection: "B2:C4", active:, formula:, sheets: [..], highlight: ["B3": .yellow]

elements.name: Tab
TabView
elements.sample: TabView() { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: Tabs
elements.sample: Tabs(["One", "Two", "Three"]) { Text("First tab").tabItem { Text("One") }; Text("Second tab").tabItem { Text("Two") } }

elements.name: Toast
elements.sample: Toast("Message sent", description: "Your reply reached 3 people.", action: "Undo", systemImage: "checkmark.circle")

elements.name: Tooltip
elements.sample: Tooltip("Share a link to this page") { Button("Share", systemImage: "square.and.arrow.up") }

elements.name: TreeItem
elements.doc: label, systemImage:, folder:, expanded:, selected:, detail:

elements.doc: poster image, progress: 0…1, time:, duration:, playing:
